credit: Source: GeoNames, Chinese postal code dump, 13 October 2026.
identity: GeoNames lists China's general codes (ending in 00); a CSC row is kept when the dump lists its code, and its type becomes 'area'
changes_by_csc: Existing codes the dump lists were kept and took its locality name, point and state; a field the dump's rows disagree on is left empty; points formatted to eight decimals; no new codes added.
state_mapping: GeoNames admin1 to the CSC state iso2 by the provider table https://www.geonames.org/CN/administrative-division-china.html
